objective: Build the complete operational architecture that consumes the accepted Phase-1 foundation without inventing schema, component, implementation, migration, APK, phone, canary, release, or production semantics.
controlling_method: research the actual frontend, native, backend, database, worker, workflow, release, and production-truth surfaces
become expert on the full operational authority and failure graph
define exact success and failure before construction
replan against every BLOCKER or HIGH finding
construct the complete bounded operational architecture
run deterministic structural and semantic validation
run fault, concurrency, replay, confused-deputy, rollback, and false-confidence attacks
correct every BLOCKER or HIGH in one bounded pass
accept only the exact immutable reviewed result
mandatory_operational_closure: each command has exact principal, credential/session context, grant, authorization decision, record type/version, aggregate, expected sequence, transaction boundary, idempotency, failure code, retry/quarantine outcome, proof, and gate

each producer, consumer, resolver, projection, API, worker, trigger, cron job, MCP tool, repair route, rollback writer, and compatibility path has one admitted authority or a signed retirement disposition

authority-set activation defines exact dependencies, preconditions, fencing owner, durable commit boundaries, old-client admission, worker draining, queue transfer, split-brain detection, mixed-generation quarantine, partial-deployment handling, and complete rollback ordering
original offline actor and authorization remain independent of later device assignment, ownership, credential, location, occurrence, or authority-set state

location rename, closure, retirement, split, merge, tag replacement, in-flight work, offline replay, notification, ticket, inspection, analytics, migration, and rollback effects are one cross-domain lifecycle contract
service occurrence, active session, completion, correction, reopen, next occurrence, readiness, inspection, notification supersession, and analytics consequences are deterministic under concurrency
Messenger, Event, Feedback, guest-disabled, contractor, AI, MCP, diagnostic, and Read Only boundaries are fail-closed and cannot acquire authority through presentation or convenience paths
restore and release represent one complete compatible authority set rather than possession of isolated backups or APKs
mandatory_attacks: anonymous or read-only principal reaches any writer
shared secret substitutes for named human or service principal
employee A offline work synchronizes after device reassignment to employee B
old APK crosses activation, rollback, location transition, and ownership change
worker crashes before and after external provider acceptance
two sessions satisfy one occurrence concurrently
Event read/save/import/cancel mutates ownership without approved impact command
message read, alert open/dismiss, scan, or Start Cleaning resolves work
legacy trigger, cron, RPC, API, tool, or stale client writes after retirement
database restore succeeds while object, queue, key, provider, or local-device recovery fails
green tests pass while producer/consumer edges, generator identity, gate dependency, or physical proof is missing
prohibited_actions: no APK build, signing, installation, or phone configuration
no canary, deployment, release, or Build 22 retirement
no compatibility patch accepted as permanent authority
no unresolved engineering obligation mislabeled as an Eric decision

required_evidence: complete exact source tuple and content manifest
all required state machines and transaction boundaries executable as deterministic fixtures
fresh independent review of the exact applied commit
matching GitHub Actions and Gmail failures reconciled
no downstream authority enabled by implication
exit_gate.authorizes_on_pass: isolated schema and component design only
